title: The Peerless Sword Saint Salaryman ~My Childhood Friend Sometimes Asks for Help to Save Humanity~
description:
In Japan where peace is maintained by the Samurai—warriors who use supernatural powers to slay disaster-bringing Phantom Beasts—Shinnosuke is nothing more than an ordinary salaryman. That changes the day he gets caught in a sudden Phantom Beast attack. To protect his sister, Himari, he finally unleashes the peerless swordsmanship he had hidden for years to strike down the beast! Now, Shinnosuke must balance his corporate life with secret missions, all while navigating his relationships with the beautiful girls in his life: Satsuki, his gorgeous childhood friend and elite Samurai, and Shizuna, his sister’s classmate and the daughter of his high-ranking boss.

The curtain rises on this high-octane, Japanese-style battle fantasy!
author: Kasane Ichiza
